title: Module adjunction for an independently sized algebraic inverse image
statement: For independently sized sites essentially small in the coefficient universe u, let F be a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint between sheaves of u-small sets and let I be a specified algebraic inverse-image lift from a ring sheaf R to RI [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image]. The functor I.modules has a right adjoint.

proof.text: Reuse the existing generic geometric module construction and linear-map transport helpers, whose site object and morphism universes are independent. The auxiliary right-module construction specializes their operation comparisons to the adjunction-transposed structural ring map.

Construct the RI-module direct image along the right adjoint using its product comparisons and the adjoint coefficient map R to F_*(RI). Its underlying sheaf is the specified direct image. Its addition and scalar action are the transported operations. The adjunction restricts to a natural bijection of linear maps because the graph equations of I preserve addition and scalar action on universal pairs and triples.

Restrict the underlying Hom equivalence to the linear maps. The addition and scalar-action graph equations are preserved and reflected by transposition, so this restriction is bijective. Faithfulness supplies both inverse identities. Naturality follows from the set-sheaf adjunction and both underlying natural isomorphisms; assemble Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv.

proof_origin.note: B9: a complete proof by restricting the natural set-sheaf Hom equivalence using the operation graph equations.

theorem inverseImageModuleAdjunction_exists
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (RI : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    (F : Sheaf J (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type u))
    (V : Sheaf K (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u))
    (adj : F ⊣ V) [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage F R RI) :
    ∃ P : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RI) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R),
      Nonempty (I.modules ⊣ P)
